The workflow tests execute the live selection block, include red rows for every fallback shape requested in round 3 plus a declared-true fallback, preserve review mode, pin the output-to-worker seam exactly, and demonstrate non-vacuity with targeted mutants including the former permissive rule. The checked-in capability declarations also match every routed persona and the briefs the worker loads. No new correctness, security, or test-validity issue is supported by the diff.
